messages:
Maya Chen: quick follow-up on the residency hint RFC — proposing an 'adaptive residency_score' attached to allocations. sketch below and tradeoffs.

Eli Park: short — sounds promising. what's the size overhead per allocation?

Maya Chen: we can pack into 1 byte if we accept 6-bit score + 2-bit tenant priority, otherwise 2 bytes for more range. example sketch:

```
struct alloc_hint {
  uint8_t residency_and_prio; // [prio:2 | score:6]
  uint8_t reuse_class;        // small class id
  uint8_t flags;              // recompute_on_touch, pinned_hint, ...
};
```

Devin O'Neill: how do we compute the score? on-alloc estimate, or dynamic based on touch recency/hotness? telemetry?

Maya Chen: initial approach: runtime sets a heuristic on alloc (shape + likely access pattern) and we update score lazily on sampled touches. full recompute on heavy tails only.

Jin Park: worried about CPU churn if we recompute on every touch. sampling + exponential decay seems safer.

Alice K: also: how does this behave across offload/migration? if a tensor is paged to host, score should drop or be marked demoted so it isn't preferentially kept.

Eli Park: fallback for clients that don't set hints: runtime inference based on model graph and access traces. clients can opt-in to override.

Devin O'Neill: fragmentation angle: if evictor always prefers low-score small objects we might increase fragmentation. need compaction interplay.

Maya Chen: agreed. plan: evictor uses composite cost = score_penalty + size_penalty + frag_penalty. compactor will prioritize adjacent low-score spans so we can defragment while respecting residency.

Jin Park: can we fold tenant QoS into the score so high-priority tenants are less likely to be evicted? maybe reserve top bits for tenant_priority.

Maya Chen: yes — reserve 2 bits for tenant_priority (00 low .. 11 critical) and 6 bits for score. that fits in one byte and is easy to check atomically.

ops-bot: checklist: add experimental flag --residency-hints, telemetry counters (score_histogram, evict_reasons), compaction traces, migration tests, perf microbench. :white_check_mark:

Alice K: rollout idea: behind feature flag, enable on dedicated canaries, monitor eviction rate and latency regressions, add per-tenant config knobs (weighting for size vs score).

Eli Park: SGTM. I'll prototype allocator layout changes + small-object metadata next week. who wants to take decay/update function?

Devin O'Neill: I'll own decay + sampling heuristics. will draft a couple candidate formulas (half-life approach vs windowed counter) and run sims.

Maya Chen: thanks — I'll put together a 1-page RFC addendum with the API sketch, config knobs, and rollout steps. tagging results in the eng-runtime RFC thread when ready.

Eli Park: sweet. can we also add a small debug endpoint to dump residency bytes for a tenant? would help triage.

Alice K: please include a Console trace link for samples so SRE/product can correlate regressions.

Maya Chen: will do. thanks all.
